check_python_version_is_38_or_above: check if the current Python interpreter version is greater than 3.8 using is_py38
check_generic_subclass_relationship: check if a typing generic alias is a subclass of a given generic type using is_generic_subclass
inspect_typing_origin_on_py38: inspect the origin of a generic alias type using typing.get_origin on Python 3.8+
inspect_typing_subclass_on_py37: inspect the subclass relationship of a generic type using issubclass on Python 3.7 and below
refactor_typing_checks_for_version: refactor the typing utility functions to remove Python 3.8 version checks once 3.6 is deprecated
